item.title: 🔍 Claude has found the culprit
item.description:
Claude unable to join meetings

Impact: major · Status: identified · Affects: claude.ai · Opened: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:10:15 +0000

Claude Meetings (beta) saw higher than expected demand today, and Claude was unable to join many calls. We have put mitigations in place and are continuing to monitor and improve join reliability. Claude Meetings is now re-enabled for all Enterprise customers, though Claude may take a little longer than usual to join. Adding Claude to new calls and Auto-join remain paused for Team customers. We will share more updates as we expand capacity and begin restoring the feature for Team customers.
